versions.content: If the Default Error Tracer has not been initialized before Det_ ReportTransientFault or Det_ReportRuntimeError reporting functions are called, these functions shall return immediately without any other action (no Error_Hook shall be used, no implementer specific function shall be performed and no error shall be re- ported).
